# Synthetic listening set (not team code, generated by Claude)

A 20 s, 48 kHz mono test set with strong treble. It is **synthetic**: a harmonic tone stack
plus hi-hat-style noise up to 24 kHz. It is not a real song.

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `synthetic_master_48k_mono.wav` | Lossless reference (what the MP3s should sound like) |
| `synthetic_56k.mp3` | 56 kbit/s encoding of the master: loses content above about 15 kHz |
| `synthetic_128k.mp3` | 128 kbit/s encoding of the master: keeps content to about 20 kHz |
| `synthetic_spectra.png` | Spectra of the master and both decoded files |
| `make_synthetic_master.py` | Script that made the master |

Encoding: `ffmpeg -i master.wav -ar 48000 -ac 1 -b:a 56k synthetic_56k.mp3` (and 128k).
For listening, play the 56k and 128k files at equal volume.
